title: BOMATA Large Kitchen Scale with 0.1g/0.001oz High Precision, 5kg/11lb Bakery Scale with% Percentage Function, USB Rechargeable, Full-View Angle LCD with Backlight, Stainless Steel Pan
description:
About this item
[ Large Size, HOLD Function ] The size of weighing platform : 7.2x7.2 inches, more convenient to weigh large-sized items. With the HOLD function, it can be measured even if the size exceeds the weighing pan.
[ 0.1g high precision and powerful function ] The built-in high quality sensor provides 0.1g accuracy and 0.5g~5kg measurement range. Powerful functions: % Percentage function, Tare , Hold function, Unit , Counting , Auto-off ( Can be canceled ), Calibration, etc.
[ % percentage function, baker's helper ] No need to calculate the gram weight of the ingredients, use the % function to operate according to the ratio, which greatly improves the efficiency.
[ Rechargeable or plugged in to use ] It can be plugged in with a USB cable for continuous use, and the built-in lithium battery can be recharged, or it can be powered by 2 AAA batteries. Use it at any time without worrying about running out of power.
[ High Quality, Multiple Accessories ] The full viewing angle LCD display can be clearly read from all angles. The weighing pan made of stainless steel is durable and easy to clean. Rich accessories: equipped with tray containers and a built-in 100g weight for calibration at any time. Package contents: Scale x 1, 100g Weight x 1, Large transparent box x 1, USB cable x 1, AAA Battery x 2, Instruction manual x 1.

reviews_5s:
This scale is VERY precise, almost too much so. The ounces go out to the thousandth measurement! Nice size for weighing dinner plates, etc. Love the hold feature and the fact that it plugs into an outlet, so we don't have to replace batteries constantly. Also love that you can turn off the automatic shutoff feature. There's nothing more irritating than trying to weigh six ounces of differing fruits, only to have it shut off while you're prepping the next fruit for weighing. The only negative is that the port for plugging in is near the front of the scale; it would keep the cord more out of the way if it plugged in back. Oh, also love that it came with a 100 gm weight for calibrating the scale.This is THE best scale in the world in my book. I have used this scale for over a year now. Still as good and reliable as day one.

If I was given a $500 scale as a gift, I would still use this one. The batteries! Options! Options! Options! I wish other electronics combined a built in battery, PLUS extra batteries, PLUS running off a plug. Why don't other companies take advantage of this? Its so cool. This thing ALWAYS turns on. Always!

The built in weight is something most scales dont have but this does. It stowes away nicely and never gets lost. It has a large platform and there are SO MANY measuring units!

I liked this scale so much, I had an unlimited budget to get my sister a scale, and I chose this one for her. This scale is a true gem. I have used it for small measurements, big measurements. Medical purposes, for mail, for gems. And even used it for weighing industrial parts and large items. You could use this to measure salt, or something as big as a small to medium size briefcase (under 5kg).

From what I can tell accuracy has always been on point. Its amazing the scale range. Honestly, I buy alot of stuff, and this is the hallmark of value. A true hidden gem in internet land. Every once in awhile, you can find a grandslam on Amazon or chinese branded products. This is a Grandslam. I cannot recommend enough. This should be standard issue for every American household.

Neither of the 2 units have ever given me problems. As mentioned before, the one I bought has been kicked around and used for over a year. Still going strong. I have never once turned it on and have it not turn on. It always has power. No issues. None. I cannot think of a single negative. This scale is a 15 out of 10.

This is... The BEST scale.
Period.This sits on our counter and is used all the time. It plugs in to charge once in a while but lasts a long time.
I even started using it to weigh ingredients for baking instead of using volume measures. Add ingredient, tare, add another, tare, etc. very easy.
Conveniently tares when you turn it on.
This one can't be submerged, but the surface is easily cleaned, and it comes with a convenient tray to put loose stuff in. The tray can go in the dishwasher.
Would recommend for an active kitchen or if you track your food intake.I loved it; my only complaint is that it doesn't stay on for a long time. reviews_1s:
First off, I would like to say I have received and tested another BOMATA Digital Scale (model BS2000), a smaller version of this scale with a higher accuracy, and I have been very impressed with its accuracy, repeatability and low latency (time to display a stable reading). But that scale was shipped in a separate box. This one came earlier in a Tyvek envelope. The instructions state that this is a precision instrument, and yet it's retail box has no cushioning whatsoever. The accuracy is off slighty even after calibration. If weight is added after it is calibrated, like the 100g calibration weight, it will usually read 100g until additional weight is added and then when that same weight is removed (see photo), it no longer reads 100g. It's stated accuracy is +/-0.2g up to 200g, but as you can see, the scale did not return to 100g. The latency of this scale is painfully slow. If you are reducing a quantity of something you're weighing to reach a desired value, it can take 3 or more seconds before you get a new stable reading after each reduction. Lastly, the instructions state:
"This product is a non-waterproof product, so be careful not to let water get in through the gaps."

The Amazon description states:
"When cleaning, please wipe it with a wet rag. Do not rinse the scale under the water."

Since this scale has units specifically for measuring liquids (ml, fl. oz), you may want to be extra careful not to spill or overfill any liquids when measuring. My personal opinion is that all kitchen scales should be waterproof against spillage on the weighing platform.

The company does make a waterproof kitchen scale, so if this is also a concern for you, you may prefer their other scale, which is lower in price as well. I have not tried that scale.This unit does not come with a true charging cord. Instead they provide a USB 'C' adapter cord. REALLY??? How cheap can you get? I turned it on, set it to weigh in grams. It began to flicker then show a rolling variety of erroneous weight measures - as there was NOTHING on the scale surface. Maybe it needed calibrating? After following the instruction, using the included 100g weight. NOPE, that didn't help. Hmmm, it might need to be charged? NOPE, charging it didn't help. Nor did inserting the 2 batteries that came with it. Very sad - it was purchased as an upgrade to the $10 scale that actually works - just doesn't TARE. I'll stick to reliable and forego the bells and whistles. The seller said this problems was 'a rare incident' and they'd refund the purchase price.
